jobs.title: VP, Digital
jobs.description:
The Vice President, Digital runs the commercial operation of the digital channel, turning merchandising, marketing and loyalty offers into activated onsite experiences that make the eCommerce plan achievable.  



  

Reporting to the SVP, Digital \& Loyalty, accountability spans onsite execution end to end: the merchandising experience, digital assortment and promo activation, online assortment expansion (2P ownership), product content health, and the product data that helps customers discover products, build intent to purchase, and ultimately convert. The mandate is delivered in close partnership with the COO organization. As the primary digital partner to the Banner Presidents and merchandising teams, the VP translates banner and category plans into onsite execution.  



  

The position also owns how customers find Canadian Tire in a changing discovery landscape. As search shifts from traditional engines to answer engines, generative surfaces and agentic shopping assistants, this role leads the SEO, AEO and GEO agenda — from early experimentation to scaled, repeatable practice. The VP is a key stakeholder in the True North eCommerce Accelerate strategy, shaping business requirements that Digital Product teams can translate into new capabilities across the digital commerce ecosystem, including Digital Harmonization, 2P and Digital Experience Drivers.  



  

**What You'll Do**  



**Digital Merchandising**


* Own the onsite merchandising experience across homepage, category pages, navigation and onsite search relevance.
* Own digital assortment presentation and promo execution onsite, aligned to banner, category and enterprise promo plans.
* Ensure marketing, merchandising and loyalty offers are activated consistently across the websites and the CTR app.
* Surface the right products earlier in the shopping journey, converting discovery into considered intent to purchase.
* Partner with Pricing \& Promo and Brand \& Marketing so onsite execution reflects the enterprise promotional calendar and price architecture.
* Serve as the senior digital partner to Banner Presidents and category teams, translating their plans into a clear onsite execution plan with visible trade\-offs where capacity is constrained.
  

**Digital Analytics \& Activation**


* Act as the key owner driving the agentic commerce ambition forward — defining how CTC's assortment, content and offers are surfaced to AI shopping assistants and agent\-mediated journeys.
* Lead the AEO and GEO agenda alongside SEO, treating traditional and AI\-driven discovery as one connected practice.
* Own onsite performance analytics, including KPI definition, competitive benchmarking and the digital measurement fact base used in commercial decisions.
* Build the measurement approach for AI\-driven discovery — visibility, citation, referral quality and downstream intent to purchase — and use it to steer investment.
* Run the digital activation and experimentation practice, converting test wins into standing site practice rather than one\-off lifts.
* Own the digital performance management rhythm: KPI reporting, performance reviews and early escalation of risks to the outlook.
* Partner with IT on the technical integrations required for search, LLM and agentic discoverability.
  

**Digital Content Operations**


* Own onsite content health across copy, imagery and specification accuracy, at the quality standard the banners expect.
* Own content grooming and meta tagging so customers can discover our products across search, generative and agentic surfaces.
* Ensure product content answers the questions that drive purchase decisions, building customer confidence and intent at the point of discovery.
* Run vendor product data onboarding, data quality and bilingual compliance, scaling throughput as assortment expands.
* Set the structured data and content standards that allow customers — and the assistants acting for them — to discover our products and understand why to choose them.
  

**Product Content Capabilities**


* Own the content platform agenda across Product 2\.0 including PIM, PCM and DAM, defining the operational requirements that the roadmap must satisfy.
* Drive product process automation and AI\-assisted rules that scale onboarding without scaling headcount.
* Lead a team of product managers and manage IT delivery of new capability and ongoing support.
* Partner with Digital Product on roadmap sequencing so capability lands against real category and banner plans.
  

**Online Assortment (2P)**


* Serve as the True North 2P initiative lead, accountable for the initiative's direction, milestones and reported outcomes.
* Build the 2P assortment expansion agenda — onboarding, content readiness and onsite presentation at scale.
* Connect 2P growth to the broader discoverability agenda so expanded assortment is surfaced to customers and AI\-driven discovery alike.
* Represent 2P progress, risks and trade\-offs in True North governance and enterprise forums.
  

**Team \& Leadership**


* Lead a multi\-disciplinary team spanning digital merchandising, analytics and activation, content operations and content management products.
* Build capability and bench strength across the function, with clear accountability at the AVP level and a deliberate approach to vacancy and succession risk.
* Set a performance culture grounded in evidence, speed and commercial ownership.
  

**What You Bring**


* Senior leadership experience in eCommerce, digital commerce or omni\-channel retail, with the ability to operate as a peer to senior commercial, banner and merchandising leaders.
* A proven record of delivering commercial results through digital execution, onsite activation and measurable customer experience improvements in a large, multi\-banner retail environment.

jobs.title: Director, Fraud Analytics & Risk Management
jobs.description:
At Manulife Bank, protecting our customers, advisors, and business from financial crime is a critical strategic priority. As Director, Fraud Analytics \& Risk Management, you will lead the Bank's fraud analytics and intelligence capabilities, leveraging advanced data analytics, customer risk modeling, and fraud technologies to proactively identify, detect, and mitigate fraud across all banking products, channels, and customer journeys.  



This role is responsible for developing a data\-driven fraud management ecosystem that delivers strong customer protection while enabling frictionless banking experiences. Working closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Digital, Data \& Analytics, and external partners, you will drive innovative solutions that enhance fraud detection, strengthen customer risk management, and improve fraud prevention outcomes.  



Reporting to the AVP/VP, Fraud Strategy \& Operations, you will play a key leadership role in shaping the future state fraud capability at Manulife Bank.  



**Position Responsibilities:**

**Lead Fraud Analytics \& Intelligence**

* Develop and execute the Bank's fraud analytics strategy across deposits, lending, mortgages, payments, digital banking, contact centre, and advisor channels.
* Establish proactive monitoring and analytical capabilities to detect emerging fraud risks, customer scams, account takeover attacks, identity theft, synthetic identities, mule activity, and organized fraud networks.
* Leverage internal and external data sources to identify fraud trends, vulnerabilities, and opportunities for control enhancement.
* Lead fraud intelligence and root\-cause analysis activities to continuously improve detection and prevention effectiveness.
Build meaningful analytics, dashboards, and executive reporting to support fraud management decision\-making.  
* 

**Own Customer Risk Scoring \& Fraud Decisioning**

* Design, develop, and continuously optimize customer fraud risk scoring models across the customer lifecycle.
* Enhance risk\-based authentication, transaction monitoring, and fraud intervention strategies.
* Leverage behavioural analytics, device intelligence, digital signals, transaction patterns, and external intelligence to improve customer risk segmentation.
* Monitor model performance and ensure appropriate governance, oversight, validation, and recalibration.
Support development of real\-time fraud detection and decisioning capabilities as the Bank evolves its payments and digital banking ecosystem.  
* 

**Advance Fraud Technology Capabilities**

* Lead evaluation, implementation, and optimization of fraud technology solutions that strengthen the Bank's fraud prevention capabilities.
* Partner with vendors to implement prevention and detection fraud toolkits
* Develop business cases and strategic recommendations for fraud technology investments.
Manage vendor relationships, performance expectations, and ongoing solution effectiveness reviews.  
* 

**Strengthen Fraud Risk Management**

* Lead comprehensive fraud risk assessments across products, processes, channels, and strategic initiatives.
* Partner with Enterprise Risk Management and Compliance teams to ensure fraud risks are appropriately identified, measured, monitored, and mitigated.
* Define and maintain fraud risk indicators, thresholds, risk appetite metrics, and reporting frameworks.
* Identify control gaps and drive remediation strategies.
Support regulatory, audit, and governance reviews related to fraud risk management.  
* 

**Enable Data\-Driven Fraud Prevention**

* Partner with Analytics on developing predictive models to improve fraud detection and prevention outcomes.
* Leverage machine learning, network analytics, behavioural analytics, anomaly detection, and AI\-enabled capabilities where appropriate.
* Balance fraud loss reduction objectives with customer experience considerations.
Translate complex analytical findings into actionable business recommendations for senior leadership.  
* 

**Lead and Develop a High\-Performing Team**

* Build and lead a team of fraud analytics, fraud intelligence, and risk professionals.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, accountability, and customer focus.
* Coach and develop talent while building future fraud analytics capabilities for the Bank.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and stakeholders on fraud risk trends, emerging threats, and mitigation strategies.  
*

* University degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business, Finance, Risk Management, or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in fraud analytics, fraud risk management, financial crimes, banking analytics, or advanced data analytics.

Experience managing fraud technology vendors and implementing fraud

jobs.title: Senior Director, Chapter Lead, Insurance Analytics
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What you'll be doing**

  

As a member of CIBC’s AI, Data and Analytics team, the Senior Director – Decision Science will lead the Insurance Decision Science team and be responsible for developing and executing strategic initiatives across a range of CIBC Insurance products and projects. This is a senior technical leadership role that combines actuarial, statistical, data science and AI enablement capabilities. The role naturally involves a comprehensive understanding of Creditor (Bank Authorized) and Non\-Authorized insurance products. You’ll exercise a high degree of independent judgement, setting the technical direction and standards for decision science activities that support pricing, profitability, growth, forecasting, portfolio performance and strategic decision making. You will develop and maintain trusted relationships across the Insurance business, larger Retail Banking organization and the technology and data science communities. In addition, you’ll translate sophisticated analysis of complex business information into clear recommendations for executives and business leaders, while providing independent challenge to assumptions, forecasts and proposed courses of action. You’ll drive innovation across areas of your responsibility and apply expert interpersonal, communication and problem\-solving skills.

  

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 1\-3 days per week on\-site, while other days will be remote.*

  

**How you'll succeed**

  

* **Strategy and Planning –** Contribute to long\-term strategy for the business in collaboration with insurance product and business leaders. Translate actuarial and advanced analytics into decisions on pricing, profitability, growth, forecasting and portfolio performance; identify opportunities, develop strategic proposals and independently challenge key assumptions and targets. Collaborate with internal partners to oversee, communicate and align business plans and ensure delivery on strategy and intended business outcomes.
* **Technical Skills \-** Set and maintain standards for actuarial, statistical, data science and AI\-enabled methods, models, tools and controls. Apply quantitative methods to identify, assess and validate the drivers of profitability, growth, market share, portfolio performance and risk exposure, and synthesize complex analysis to influence business decisions and outcomes. Establish forward\-looking performance measurement, forecasting, product analysis and decision\-support capabilities that enable timely action, rather than reporting results alone.
* **People Management \-** Own the team’s capability and talent strategy, including workforce planning, succession, hiring, development, coaching and deployment of actuarial and analytics talent against business priorities. Build differentiated technical capabilities, establish clear role and proficiency standards, and create development pathways that strengthen the team over time. Manage capacity to ensure initiatives are appropriately staffed, identify capability gaps and remove obstacles to performance. Create a positive work environment and role model by championing CIBC’s mission, vision and values. Comply with policies, standards, guidelines and controls by applying them fairly and consistently so employees understand what to expect.
  

**Who you are**

  

* **You are a senior actuarial and analytics leader with strong quantitative knowledge and relevant industry experience.** You are an actuary, and hold an advanced degree an actuarial, data science, analytics or related technical field, or equivalent experience, and bring senior\-level experience in insurance.
* **You have a high degree of Insurance product knowledge and understand the regulatory landscape.** You have expert knowledge of insurance products (both authorized and non\-authorized), banking and insurance frameworks, and the risk and compliance considerations that shape product decisions.
* **You can demonstrate extensive experience** in product management, strategic planning, and project management sufficient to identify, develop, and implement approved initiatives. You have strong analytical, problem\-solving skills, excellent communication and presentation skills sufficient to prepare and present material to an executive audience.
* **You give meaning to data.** You enjoy investigating complex problems, and making sense of information. You're confident in your ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way.
* **You’re an effective leader and collaborator.** You build strong relationships across teams, use sound judgment, manage multiple priorities effectively and help create an environment where people can do their best work **.** You are a technical leader, not a distant administrator. You remain intellectually engaged in the methods, systems, and decisions that determine whether the work succeeds.
* **You act like an owner.** You thrive when you're empowered to take the lead, go above and beyond, and deliver results.
* **Values matter to you** . You bring your real self to work and you live our values \- trust, teamwork, and accountability.
  

  

\#LI\-TA

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paychec

jobs.title: Director, Canada Strategy
jobs.description:
At Manulife Canada, the Strategy \& Transformation team sits at the center of the organization, partnering closely with the Canada CEO and Segment leaders to shape and advance the company’s long\-term direction.


We work across business lines and functions to translate Segment strategy into aligned priorities, maintain an integrated view of the strategic portfolio, shape high\-impact initiatives, and improve the processes through which strategic and investment decisions are made.

  

  

As Director, Canada Strategy, you will help shape Manulife Canada’s strategy and advance its most critical priorities. You will combine enterprise perspective, structured problem solving, and constructive challenge to help senior leaders make clear choices and mobilize action.


This high\-visibility role spans strategy reviews, strategic initiatives, and business and functional deep dives. The Director will act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and help connect Canada Segment priorities with business unit and functional plans.

  

  

This role is ideal for a strategy leader who has shaped enterprise or business\-unit strategy in a complex organization or top\-tier consulting environment and is equally comfortable developing strategy, facilitating executive decisions, and moving priority initiatives toward execution.

  

  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  

  

**Strategy Cascade and Enterprise Visibility**

  

  

* Translate Canada Segment strategy into clear priorities, expectations, and decision criteria for business units and functions.
* Lead periodic strategy reviews and structured check\-ins to assess progress, test whether priorities remain valid, and identify where leadership intervention is required.
* Maintain an integrated view of the strategic portfolio, including both funded initiatives and material work outside the formal book of work, to identify gaps, overlaps, dependencies, and emerging risks.
* Synthesize business unit and functional strategies to assess how they collectively advance Canada Segment objectives.
* Help develop and communicate the narrative of the Canada Segment strategy to Enterprise leadership and the Board.
  

  

**Strategic Initiatives and Enterprise Problem Solving**


* Lead high\-priority, cross\-business strategic initiatives from problem definition through recommendation, mobilization, and transition to accountable execution owners.
* Frame and evaluate strategic choices, including where to enter, exit, invest, partner, acquire, simplify, or double down.
* Develop fact\-based recommendations through structured problem solving, market and competitive analysis, financial assessment, scenario analysis, and stakeholder input.
* Develop business cases and implementation roadmaps, establish intended outcomes and success measures, and secure senior leadership alignment.
* Support partnership and M\&A assessments, including strategic fit, value creation logic, key risks, and integration considerations, in collaboration with relevant subject\-matter experts.
  

  

**Business and Functional Deep Dives**


* Lead periodic vertical and horizontal deep dives across businesses and functions, for example – Distribution, Technology, Operations, and other enterprise capabilities.
* Act as the Canada Segment’s thought and challenge partner to functions, testing strategic ambition, investment priorities, operating choices, and alignment with business needs.
* Identify cross\-business opportunities, shared capabilities, and structural barriers that may not be visible within individual portfolios.
* Facilitate alignment across business and functional leaders where priorities, accountabilities, or investment choices are unclear.
  

  

**Executive Advisory and Team Leadership**


* Provide independent, forward\-looking advice to senior executives and facilitate decisions on complex or ambiguous strategic topics.
* Develop concise executive and Board\-ready materials that clarify the issue, choices, trade\-offs, recommendation, and required decision.
* Build alignment across business units, functions, and enterprise partners through effective facilitation, influence, and constructive challenge.
* Lead and develop a high\-performing, inclusive team with strong capabilities in strategic judgment, structured problem solving, executive communication, and delivery.
* Coach direct reports and peers, allocate resources to the highest\-value priorities
* Strengthen the Strategy \& Transformation team’s methods and capabilities – including via the adoption of AI, better operating rhythms, common approaches, etc.
  

  

**Leadership Capabilities**


* Strategic Judgment: Connect enterprise context, market evidence, economics, and execution realities to make clear recommendations.
* Structured Problem Solving: Break ambiguous issues into testable hypotheses, focused analyses, and practical choices.
* Influence and Constructive Challenge: Build credibility with senior leaders while testing assumptions and surfacing trade\-offs.
* Executive Communication: Distill complex issues into concise, decision\-oriented narratives and Board\-ready materials.
* Enterprise Collaboration: Create alignment across business units and functions without relying on formal authority.
* Mobilization and Execution: Translate strategy into clear outcomes, accountabilities, success measures, and an executable path forward.
* Talent Development: Coach and develop high\-performing strategy talent and raise the quality of thinking across the team.
  

  

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

  

* 8–10\+ years of progressively senior experience in corporate strategy, business strategy, management consulting, corporate development, transformation, or a related field.
* Experience in financial services and/or a top\-tier consulting firm strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience shaping enterprise or business\-unit strategy across multiple businesses, functions, or geographies.
* Strong financial acume

BMO Capital Markets is a member of BMO Financial Group (NYSE, TSX: BMO), one of the largest diversified financial services providers in North America with US$1\.0 trillion total assets and approximately 54,000 employees as of January 31, 2025\.


**What is the opportunity?**

The Data Cognition Team (DCT) is BMO Capital Markets’ AI engineering and enablement team, with nearly a decade of experience building and deploying AI solutions in complex, regulated financial services environments.  

  



As Vice President, AI Strategy \& Product Management, you will operate at the intersection of business strategy, product management, and AI. You will own the vision, strategy, roadmap, delivery, and adoption of high\-value AI and data products, working closely with front\-office users, senior leaders, engineers, data scientists, UX, risk, and compliance partners.  



  

The successful candidate will bring the judgment, influence, and hands\-on product leadership required to scale trusted AI and data products and capabilities in a highly regulated Capital Markets environment.  



**What will you do?**

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Director
jobs.description:
**About Beacon Software**
-------------------------


Beacon is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder\-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore.  

  

Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI\-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable.  

  

We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better.  

  

Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M\+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game.

**Role and Mission**
--------------------


This is an exciting and entrepreneurial opportunity to join a fast\-paced technology company with a very significant growth trajectory. Beacon Software is making its first hire on the Strategic Finance team. This is a role where investing turns into building. The individual will report to Beacon’s VP, Strategic Finance and work closely with Beacon’s CEO, CTO, M\&A Directors, industry pod leaders, and the General Managers of Beacon’s portfolio companies.


The Strategic Finance team’s mandate spans the financial decisions that shape Beacon: partnering with portfolio companies on growth and value creation, building AI\-native systems that let functions scale non\-linearly with the portfolio, owning Beacon’s capital allocation across organic and inorganic strategies, leading new strategy extensions beyond core software M\&A, and building Beacon’s capital markets capability. Team members work across a mix of these areas based on their interests and skillset.


This is an asymmetric opportunity to build a company, with decision authority and velocity over process driving compounding equity. You’ll sit next to the CEO on capital allocation and capital markets, or fill a CFO role across dozens of companies on their most consequential decisions. The playbook will be shaped by you with the goal of building Beacon into a $100B company.


To succeed in this role, this individual should be an enthusiastic and energetic self\-starter, with the ability to translate operator intuition into financial decisions and build the analytical rigor behind Beacon’s platform\-level bets. The ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously across portfolio companies and platform initiatives will be essential. We are seeking a collaborative professional who wants to contribute ideas on how to improve the status quo and create best\-practices that will accelerate our execution. Teamwork and positivity are key foundations of this growing team’s culture and ethos.

**Location:** for discussion. Beacon has offices in Toronto, San Francisco, New York, and Chicago.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Finance partner to acquired companies**

* Partner with industry sector leaders and portfolio company General Managers as the financial decision\-making engine across Beacon’s portfolio companies.
* Translate product, AI, and operator intuition into investment decisions: pricing changes, sales hires, direct marketing investments, engineering allocation, and tuck\-in M\&A.
* Build value creation plans, set budgets and targets, and make the day\-to\-day capital decisions that drive growth across companies.

**Beacon capital allocation**

* Help own platform\-level capital allocation: organic platform investment vs. inorganic M\&A, platform\-level acquisitions vs. tuck\-ins, debt vs. equity at the corporate level.
* Build the analytical rigor behind Beacon’s platform\-level bets, ensuring capital is deployed where returns are most asymmetric.

**Strategy extension beyond core software M\&A**

* Own thesis through acquisition through ownership for new strategy extensions, starting with software\-plus\-services vertical integration in end markets where Beacon already owns software.
* Partner with the M\&A team for execution while driving the strategy, the diligence, and the post\-close build.

**Capital markets**

* Lead Beacon’s debt strategy, support future equity raises, and prepare Beacon for an eventual IPO.
* Build best\-in\-class debt and equity investor relations and position Beacon as an institutional\-grade capital allocator.

**Build AI\-native finance systems**

* Partner with Beacon’s CTO and engineering leadership on the company\-wide tools that scale across the portfolio, including BeaconOS and AI\-native financial systems.
* Build the systems, dashboards, and decision frameworks that let sector leaders and GMs self\-serve the financial answers they need, allowing the finance function to scale non\-linearly with the portfolio.

* Strong academic record from a competitive institution with a degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
* Investor mindset, analytical toolkit, and operator instinct: equally comfortable building a model and being in the room with a product leader or GM helping them make the call.

jobs.title: Director Commercial Pricing and Data Governance
jobs.description:
Purpose:


As the Director of Commercial Pricing and Data Governance at UNFI, you are responsible for developing and executing the company's enterprise\-wide pricing strategy while leading the Data Governance function. Your role is critical in driving commercial excellence, ensuring data integrity, and enabling informed business decisions across the organization.



In the area of pricing, your scope includes building and leading a centralized pricing department that will define, govern, and continuously improve UNFI Canada’s brand and customer pricing strategy. This role will move the organization toward a more disciplined pricing model, shifting pricing ownership away from Sales over time so that Sales can remain focused on customer relationships, execution of brand strategies, and commercial growth. You will immediately assume leadership of pricing activities currently managed within SRM and RGM, while developing the structure, tools, processes, resource requirements, governance model, and transition plan required to bring Sales pricing responsibilities into the pricing organization in the medium term. You will establish clear decision\-making protocols, pricing guardrails, escalation processes, analytical capabilities, and best practices to support consistent, data\-driven pricing decisions that improve margin performance, strengthen customer and supplier strategies, and deliver both immediate and long\-term revenue value.



In the area of Data Governance, you will lead the Retalix Pricing, Retalix Maintenance, and MCB teams. You are accountable for ensuring data quality, governance, and integrity across Supplier Services, including pricing updates, GS1 data management, new brand onboarding information, and system master data maintenance. Your leadership will ensure that core data processes are effectively managed and aligned with business and operational requirements.



By partnering closely with cross\-functional teams and senior leaders, you will enable the successful execution of UNFI's strategic priorities through the effective use of data and analytics. You will foster a culture of accountability, agility, and data\-driven decision\-making while ensuring alignment with UNFI's vision and objectives. Ultimately, your role is to drive sustainable revenue growth, improve profitability, and maximize the value of data as a strategic asset across the organization.



Job Responsibilities:



Lead Pricing Strategy (50%)


* Develop the brand and customer pricing strategy for UNFI Canada
* Review and optimize our current pricing tools and governance
* Immediately take on SRM/RGM pricing and bring forward the recommendation (inclusive of tools and resources) to take pricing on from the sales team
* Establish and enforce guardrails, policies, and pricing strategies to ensure adherence to revenue targets, margin optimization, and overall revenue growth.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and provide deep understanding of customer economics, supplier dynamics, and market sensitivities to enable win\-win pricing and solution proposals.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Supplier Services, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Legal, Finance, and IT, to address executional barriers, develop innovative pricing solutions, and align strategies with organizational objectives and initiatives.
* Collect and communicate IT business requirements and play key role in deployment of technical and system enhancements to ensure minimal risk to internal and external customers


Data Governance (30%)


* Drive the implementation of data governance practices and ensure effective utilization of data analytics for prescriptive insights across all teams, supporting data\-driven decision\-making processes
* Conduct continuous reviews of revenue strategies, team processes, and systems to identify areas for improvement, scalability, and efficiency gains.

**Job Description**

**WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?**

  

Director, ALM Analytics \& Applied Research is responsible for research, simulation, and forecasting of RBC’s Canadian banking balance sheet and income statement for the purpose of measuring stress exposure, in support of the Bank's Asset Liability Management, IRRBB metrics, and stress testing. The role focuses on econometric modeling of client behaviour assumptions for retail banking products, with strong emphasis on statistics, fixed income valuation modeling, and database management. Responsibilities include applied research relating to behavioural options in retail banking, risk and simulation model development, design input and output criteria, model performance evaluation, model and assumption documentation, process design, and econometric research related to dynamic forecasting assumptions.

 **WHAT WILL YOU DO?**

* Simulate and forecast Canadian Banking balance sheet and income statement under stress scenarios for purposes of IRRBB risk measurement.
* Develop econometric models for forecasting purposes to project cashflows of RBC banking book positions used for IRRBB measurement, using internal and external time series and panel data sets; maintain strong database extract, transform, and load capabilities; and leverage industry, economic, and market information to improve model intelligence through liaison with internal and external resources.
* Design, develop, and implement robust financial risk, valuation, and forecast models within RBC’s QRM risk engine.
* Conduct research and analytics pertaining to model inputs and assumptions, ensuring correct model use and governance requirements.
* Evaluate internal and external data to understand balance sheet dynamics, product characteristics, client behaviour, and balance sheet flows with focus on retail banking products.
* Lead and perform end\-to\-end modelling responsibilities, including process evaluation of data quality, model performance tracking, ensuring consistency across models employed for forecasting and stress testing, and maintaining clear documentation of approach, methodologies, and processes.
* Maintain requisite model governance, model documentation, model inventory, and process mapping requirements. Ensure efficient and effective model risk and compliance management, including performance of regular model validation submissions and model finding remediations.
* Leveraging industry best practices including use of AI, develop and implement an internal toolkit for assessing hypotheses and mathematical models behind applied and proposed risk methodologies, stress testing, and projections.
* Consider, understand, and evaluate general ledger, accounting and finance, and regulatory reporting processes, as they relate to IRRBB measurement, management, and modelling.
* Perform ad hoc scenario analysis in support of balance sheet IRRBB hedging, with high degree of interaction with business units to promote business segment review, challenge, and alignment.

 **WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?**

 **Must\-have:**

* Graduate degree in a quantitative field such as financial engineering, mathematics, statistics, or economics.
* 7\+ years related experience with a strong grasp of ALM practices.
* Understanding of banking book balance sheet dynamics, product characteristics, client behaviour, and balance sheet flows, with focus on retail banking products.
* Solid understanding of financial principles and risk concepts, including financial modelling and engineering, pricing models, econometrics, and fixed income mathematics.
* Excellent capabilities in statistical and analytical principles, tools, and techniques.
* Strong understanding of applicable regulatory guidelines and accounting principles, and related systems.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Well\-organized and detail oriented, with ability to tailor analysis to the required level of precision.

* CFA and/or FRM designations, or equivalent.
* Prior exposure to ALM risk engine platforms and software (e.g., QRM or similar).

**About Modular Solutions**



Founded in 2015, Modular Solutions delivers enterprise\-grade technology to the insurance industry. Our configurable platform helps insurers, mutuals, MGAs, and brokers manage core operations through a single system designed for flexibility, long\-term growth, and complex regulated environments.

  


**Position Summary**



Modular Solutions is seeking a Director of Data \& Analytics to own the architecture and governance of our data and analytics platform and how our data is turned into decisions, so that the data we collect becomes reporting and answers that clients and teams can trust as we continue to grow our platform, client base, and internal capabilities.

  



Reporting to the CTO, this role leads the Data function, including data engineering, data science, business intelligence, analytics, and migration, and owns the architecture of the data and analytics platform that connects them. While the data and analytics platform is the primary focus, the role also contributes to and collaborates on the data architecture and design of our core application alongside our Product and Development teams.

  



The ideal candidate is a hands\-on leader who sets direction and stays close to the work: designing the analytics data architecture, data models, and semantic layer alongside engineers rather than managing from a distance. You should bring deep experience in data architecture, data modelling, BI and analytics, and data governance, with a working knowledge of data migration and AI\-enabled workflows, along with the ability to lead people, prioritize work, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

  



This role is well suited for someone who can build structure, develop teams, improve processes, and help Modular responsibly adopt data and AI practices that create real value for clients, employees, and the platform.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Set the data strategy and long\-term roadmap for the Data function, including platforms, vendors, budget, and cost, and build a high\-performing team across data engineering, BI and analytics, and data migration.
* Own the data and analytics platform architecture: the target\-state design for how data flows out of our application into ingestion and pipelines, the data warehouse and data marts, the semantic layer, and the BI and AI tools that consume them, supported by reference architectures and documented architecture decisions.
* Define and maintain the analytics data model for insurance data, including policy, billing, claims, bordereaux, brokers, and coverage, aligned with the application's data model, so that migration, reporting, and analytics map to it consistently.
* Collaborate with Product and Development on the data architecture and design of our core application: bring a data perspective to schema and data model design, assess the downstream impact of changes, favour incremental improvements over large\-scale redesign, and establish data contracts so that application changes do not break reporting, integrations, or client deliverables.
* Own metric governance: a single set of business definitions and KPIs with clear owners, implemented once in the semantic layer and consumed consistently by BI, client reporting, and AI.
* Design how clients access their reporting and analytics data, including governed data sharing and extracts, partnering with product engineering where access runs through application APIs, with appropriate tenant isolation, security, and performance.
* Set standards for data quality, governance, privacy, security, and data residency, including PII classification, retention, lineage, and access control, in support of our security and compliance programs.
* Establish a data quality and validation framework, including automated reconciliation, testing, and certification of trusted datasets and AI\-generated outputs, so that our teams and clients can trust results at scale.
* Define the reporting operating model for standard and client\-specific reporting, including intake and prioritization, move clients toward governed self\-service analytics, and deliver executive\-level insights and advanced analytics, such as forecasting, where they create clear business value.
* Build data migration and onboarding into a repeatable capability, with a reusable conversion framework, reconciliation, and post\-migration validation, led by a dedicated migration lead.
* Build AI\-ready data foundations so that AI features call governed data and semantic models rather than calculating on their own, lead AI adoption within the Data team, and help define the product direction for self\-service and AI\-assisted analytics.
* Partner with Product, Development, Implementation, Operations, and leadership to align priorities, and communicate progress, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to executives.
* Perform other duties as required to support the Data function.

* Proven experience designing enterprise data architecture, including data models, data warehouses and marts, ETL/ELT pipelines, semantic models, and the integration between operational systems and analytics platforms, with a track record of collaborating with application engineering teams on data design and improving existing systems incrementally.
* Hands\-on experience building and governing business definitions, metrics, or semantic models, and working directly with engineers to implement them.

new_jobs.description:
**About Beacon Software**
-------------------------


Beacon is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder\-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore.  

  

Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI\-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable.  

  

We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better.  

  

Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M\+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game.

**Role and Mission**
--------------------


This is an exciting and entrepreneurial opportunity to join a fast\-paced technology company with a very significant growth trajectory. Beacon Software is making its first hire on the Strategic Finance team. This is a role where investing turns into building. The individual will report to Beacon’s VP, Strategic Finance and work closely with Beacon’s CEO, CTO, M\&A Directors, industry pod leaders, and the General Managers of Beacon’s portfolio companies.


The Strategic Finance team’s mandate spans the financial decisions that shape Beacon: partnering with portfolio companies on growth and value creation, building AI\-native systems that let functions scale non\-linearly with the portfolio, owning Beacon’s capital allocation across organic and inorganic strategies, leading new strategy extensions beyond core software M\&A, and building Beacon’s capital markets capability. Team members work across a mix of these areas based on their interests and skillset.


This is an asymmetric opportunity to build a company, with decision authority and velocity over process driving compounding equity. You’ll sit next to the CEO on capital allocation and capital markets, or fill a CFO role across dozens of companies on their most consequential decisions. The playbook will be shaped by you with the goal of building Beacon into a $100B company.

new_jobs.title: Director of Data and Analytics
new_jobs.description:
**About Modular Solutions**



Founded in 2015, Modular Solutions delivers enterprise\-grade technology to the insurance industry. Our configurable platform helps insurers, mutuals, MGAs, and brokers manage core operations through a single system designed for flexibility, long\-term growth, and complex regulated environments.

  


**Position Summary**



Modular Solutions is seeking a Director of Data \& Analytics to own the architecture and governance of our data and analytics platform and how our data is turned into decisions, so that the data we collect becomes reporting and answers that clients and teams can trust as we continue to grow our platform, client base, and internal capabilities.

  



Reporting to the CTO, this role leads the Data function, including data engineering, data science, business intelligence, analytics, and migration, and owns the architecture of the data and analytics platform that connects them. While the data and analytics platform is the primary focus, the role also contributes to and collaborates on the data architecture and design of our core application alongside our Product and Development teams.

  



The ideal candidate is a hands\-on leader who sets direction and stays close to the work: designing the analytics data architecture, data models, and semantic layer alongside engineers rather than managing from a distance. You should bring deep experience in data architecture, data modelling, BI and analytics, and data governance, with a working knowledge of data migration and AI\-enabled workflows, along with the ability to lead people, prioritize work, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

  



This role is well suited for someone who can build structure, develop teams, improve processes, and help Modular responsibly adopt data and AI practices that create real value for clients, employees, and the platform.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* Set the data strategy and long\-term roadmap for the Data function, including platforms, vendors, budget, and cost, and build a high\-performing team across data engineering, BI and analytics, and data migration.
* Own the data and analytics platform architecture: the target\-state design for how data flows out of our application into ingestion and pipelines, the data warehouse and data marts, the semantic layer, and the BI and AI tools that consume them, supported by reference architectures and documented architecture decisions.
* Define and maintain the analytics data model for insurance data, including policy, billing, claims, bordereaux, brokers, and coverage, aligned with the application's data model, so that migration, reporting, and analytics map to it consistently.
* Collaborate with Product and Development on the data architecture and design of our core application: bring a data perspective to schema and data model design, assess the downstream impact of changes, favour incremental improvements over large\-scale redesign, and establish data contracts so that application changes do not break reporting, integrations, or client deliverables.
* Own metric governance: a single set of business definitions and KPIs with clear owners, implemented once in the semantic layer and consumed consistently by BI, client reporting, and AI.
* Design how clients access their reporting and analytics data, including governed data sharing and extracts, partnering with product engineering where access runs through application APIs, with appropriate tenant isolation, security, and performance.
* Set standards for data quality, governance, privacy, security, and data residency, including PII classification, retention, lineage, and access control, in support of our security and compliance programs.
* Establish a data quality and validation framework, including automated reconciliation, testing, and certification of trusted datasets and AI\-generated outputs, so that our teams and clients can trust results at scale.
* Define the reporting operating model for standard and client\-specific reporting, including intake and prioritization, move clients toward governed self\-service analytics, and deliver executive\-level insights and advanced analytics, such as forecasting, where they create clear business value.
* Build data migration and onboarding into a repeatable capability, with a reusable conversion framework, reconciliation, and post\-migration validation, led by a dedicated migration lead.
* Build AI\-ready data foundations so that AI features call governed data and semantic models rather than calculating on their own, lead AI adoption within the Data team, and help define the product direction for self\-service and AI\-assisted analytics.
* Partner with Product, Development, Implementation, Operations, and leadership to align priorities, and communicate progress, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to executives.
* Perform other duties as required to support the Data function.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* 8\+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, or a related data field, including designing data platforms or data models at an organizational level.
* 3\+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical teams, while remaining hands\-on in the work.
* Proven experience designing enterprise data architecture, including data models, data warehouses and marts, ETL/ELT pipelines, semantic models, and the integration between operational systems and analytics platforms, with a track record of collaborating with application engineering teams on data design and improving existing systems incrementally.
* Hands\-on experience building and governing business definitions, metrics, or semantic models, and working directly with engineers to implement them.
* Strong grounding in data governance, data quality, privacy, and security, including access control, PII handling, lineage, and validation of data and reporting outputs.
